title: Eighth 100 medium-machine candidates: direction-aware facsimile headword/boundary review
provenance_note: AI-assisted visual collation against the Steffel 1809 facsimile for the eighth medium-confidence cohort in deterministic source order. This batch crosses the printed p. 353 German→Rarámuri / Rarámuri→German transition; direction was therefore established from documentary section layout before boundary decisions. The facsimile is authoritative and preserved OCR is secondary. Review is not independent human/philological or linguistic validation.
